name: kpet-bridge
description: KPet 转发器（kpet-bridge）与进程间通信协议包。对应 docs/MVP设计.md §3/§4

scripts.build:exe: npm run build && node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('bin',{recursive:true})" && bun build --compile --windows-hide-console dist/launcher/main.js --outfile bin/kpetd.exe
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-force-exit "dist-test/test/*.test.js"
